CustomField.label: Integration Pattern
CustomField.description: The technical mechanism this external system uses to exchange data with Salesforce, such as a real-time API call, a scheduled batch job, a Change Data Capture or Platform Event subscription, an Outbound Message, or Salesforce Connect. This matters when assessing impact, because real-time and CDC integrations tend to fail loudly and immediately when metadata changes, while batch integrations may fail silently until the next scheduled run.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How this system exchanges data with Salesforce.
